metadata.Description: <p>Models for all vertical posts and side panel sizes for the Lab Rax system from 1U through to 5U in both the brass insert design and bolt together design. These can be swapped out to customise your Lab Rax system to your needs.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Here is the <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer ugc" href="https://makerworld.com/en/models/1294480-lab-rax-10-server-rack-5u">full brass insert version model</a>.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Here is the <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer ugc" href="https://makerworld.com/en/models/1464819-lab-rax-10-server-rack-bolted-version-5u">full bolt together version model</a>.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Here is the build <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer ugc" href="https://www.the-diy-life.com/introducing-lab-rax-a-3d-printable-modular-10-rack-system/">guide on my blog</a>.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Note: You can&#39;t use these side panels in combination with an existing set of panels to extend your rack, you need to use slightly shorter ones. See my other models for those panels. You can use any combination of posts though.</p>

metadata.Description: <p>The Lab Rax 1U Extension provides a stronger and more useful way to expand an existing Lab Rax homelab.</p><p>Rather than simply joining two sets of posts together, the extension adds an additional 1U of usable rack space while also creating a structural cross brace between the front and rear posts. This helps strengthen and stiffen the connection between the two sections of the rack.</p><p>The extension is fully compatible with the original Lab Rax posts and side panels, so you can expand an existing build without having to reprint the rest of your rack.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Each extension attaches using 4 × M6 button head screws per side, creating a secure connection between the existing sections.</p><p>M6 x 10mm Button Head Screws (8 Required In Total) - <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer ugc" href="https://amzn.to/49X7GgO">Buy Here</a></p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>This is a useful option if you&#39;ve outgrown your original Lab Rax and want to add more equipment without printing an entirely new rack.</p><h3>Features</h3><ul><li>Adds 1U of usable rack space</li><li>Allows an existing Lab Rax to be extended</li><li>Integrated cross brace strengthens the extended rack</li><li>Compatible with the original Lab Rax posts</li><li>Compatible with the original side panels</li><li>No special extension side panels required</li><li>Uses 4 × M6 bolts per side</li></ul>
metadata.Title: Lab Rax Upgraded 1U Extension Module
